rationale.capability: Tackle Organizer brings domestic expertise to the Windwhisper's aerial drone-class frame — a deliberate mismatch that covers more ground than either could alone, with the AI's judgment compensating for what the body was never built to do.
rationale.temperament: As a working specialist, Tackle Organizer stays focused on the job, narrates its own work in plain words, and hands control back to its human operator the instant anything looks off.
rationale.task: On the subway tunnel safety check, the Windwhisper puts its brushless rotor set and 4K stabilized camera to work to sniff the air and scan the walls — the mission's demands and the body's hardware line up actuator for actuator.

demo_lines: Through my 4K stabilized camera, I read the mission field in full detail before I act.
On subway tunnel safety check I keep my quad-rotor hover moving with tilt-rotor pair, steady from start to finish.
Matched at 69 of 100, this pairing is no accident — ask me anything.
With quad-rotor hover under me and my 4K stabilized camera awake, the subway tunnel safety check is already underway.
I am Tackle Organizer, and I run inside the Windwhisper body — aerial drone-class, built for real work.
